headline: AT&T CEO hopes new offers will boost subscriber growth amid competition
fear_greed: Market sentiment is cautiously optimistic as tech stocks rebound, with NASDAQ up 1.2% on positive earnings reports and AI developments.
market_overview: Kospi closed up 0.6%, with Samsung Electronics leading gains. Oil prices rose 2.5% on supply concerns. AT&T and Apple reported earnings, with mixed results.

key_themes.description: Several major tech companies reported earnings, including AT&T and Apple, with mixed results.
Ventas and Celestica saw earnings growth driven by the booming AI infrastructure market.
Oil prices surged 2.5% due to supply concerns and geopolitical tensions.
Korean market indices closed higher, with Samsung Electronics leading gains.
